what: Whop (citing SimilarWeb) reports Etsy's social media traffic breakdown: Pinterest drove 41% of social traffic, YouTube 24%, Reddit 12%, Facebook 11%; organic traffic accounted for 31% of visits, social and paid search each accounted for 9%.
verbatim_snippet: "At 41%, Pinterest drove the most traffic to Etsy. Other social networks that sent traffic to Etsy included YouTube (24%), Reddit (12%) and Facebook (11%)."
notes: Secondary source citing SimilarWeb. Social traffic data attributed to November 2024 in article context. Fetch status uncertain; degraded to provisional. Same source reports: "Organic traffic accounted for 31% of visits, while social and paid search each accounted for 9%."
